title: SWIFT Shared Ledger
question: What has SWIFT's shared-ledger program moved from experiment toward service, and which operator, access, rulebook, corridor and settlement questions remain unresolved?
bluf: SWIFT's controlled rollout has bank-reported live transactions, including September 10 domestic SGD activity among DBS, OCBC and UOB, while customer availability, bank-specific deposit obligations and final settlement remain separate. Oracle's September 28 announcement adds a bank-side implementation route: Oracle can supply the EVM ledger, wallets, commitment contracts, event workflows and ISO 20022 payment processing while SWIFT coordinates shared state and the banks retain their liabilities, keys, funding and settlement choices. No named Oracle bank, Oracle-facilitated transaction, general-availability receipt, public rulebook or measured scale is established; Digital Assets Data Nexus remains planned for fiscal 2027.
evidence_cutoff_note: Focused Sibos overlap and gap audit through September 28, 2026, 12:23 EDT. Existing packages already own the authority, settlement, accounting, smart-contract, correction/loss, route/anchor and DLT proof boundaries; the narrow live gaps are the scheme conformance constitution, SWIFT B2B agentic receipt, executable standards artefacts and exact corridor roles. The Oracle/SWIFT delta is current through 10:04 EDT and the complete 17-bank census retains its September 9 cutoff. Sibos continues through October 1; no named Oracle bank, executed Oracle transaction, operative adapter version, price, service level or public loss/finality rulebook was located.
use_note: Start with the September 28 Oracle integration audit for the newest bank-side adapter and product-state delta, then the September 9 operating answer and all-bank companion for the broader transaction baseline. Oracle, IBM and Taurus are nonexclusive vendor routes, not deposit issuers or final-settlement operators. Direct ledger activity, vendor capability, Swift messaging compatibility, earlier Swift trials and adjacent bank systems remain distinct; source dates and finality limits travel with the cards.

For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
